description.value: Eagle Rock Bed and Breakfast is a small, adult-only luxury retreat in Chemainus, BC, positioned steps from a pebble beach with ocean views along Vancouver Island's coast. It offers two private rooms (a king and a queen) and serves hearty gourmet breakfasts. The property markets itself as a serene, exclusive escape, appealing to cyclists looking for a quieter, upscale overnight stop on the Island.
